name: brewlite-monorepo
description: BrewLite - Mobile-First Beverage Ordering & Payment System (Monorepo)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test:backend: npm test --prefix apps/api && npm run test:e2e --prefix apps/api
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:postman
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/api && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
